skills_requirements_derived: One canonical run manifest must own repeated identities; briefs and preregistrations must be generated projections rather than manually copied hash tables.
Preflight helpers must emit machine-readable evidence and fail before task creation when parent inputs disagree.
Artifact roots must be created and verified before nested test or cache paths are handed to workers.
Mutating normalization steps such as formatter application must be distinct from check-only acceptance Gates.
Run history must be append-only; recovery binds exact candidate bytes, Git identity and commands without rewriting failed predecessors.
Finish must audit ordinary, untracked and ignored state separately and must not silently clean evidence residue.
Public Gate, review and sealed Gate must remain separately authorized phases, with expensive Gates executed only for new facts.
